description: A path-traced (photo-real) image: glass, lamps and the sky's light, saved on the user's computer. Takes from under a minute to many minutes: samples 64 is a quick draft, 256 good (default), 1024 best; bigger images take longer. Set the sky (set_sky) and sun (set_sun) and the camera (a saved view) first. The user sees Stori3D busy meanwhile. Returns where it was saved.

view.description: current (default), overview, or a saved view

name: render_image
title: Render a realistic image
